ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$, and the chord $CD \perp AB$ at point $E$. If $AB=26$ and $EB=8$, find the length of chord $CD$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Draw line $OC$ as shown in the diagram:\\
Since $AB$ is the diameter of circle $O$ and $CD \perp AB$,\\
it follows that $CE=DE=\frac{1}{2}CD$, $OC=OB=\frac{1}{2}AB=13$,\\
therefore $OE=OB-EB=13-8=5$,\\
In the right-angled triangle $\triangle OCE$, by the Pythagorean theorem, we have $CE=\sqrt{OC^{2}-OE^{2}}=12$,\\
thus, $CD=2CE=\boxed{24}$.
